- On Tuesdays and Thursdays: \(2 \text{ classes} \times 2 \text{ hours/class} = 4 \text{ hours}\)

Total hours per week:
\[3 \text{ hours} + 4 \text{ hours} = 7 \text{ hours/week}\]

For the entire semester (16 weeks):
\[7 \text{ hours/week} \times 16 \text{ weeks} = 112 \text{ hours}\]

So, Kimo spends a total of 112 hours attending classes in one semester.
